title: The Dream of Grandshaykh `AbdAllah Fa'iz ad-Daghestani (q)
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh gives bay`a to the group.)
While he was still living, Grandshaykh `AbdAllah (q) said to me, "Shaykh Nazim! Last night I drempt I was
standing and looking, and you were also looking. In front of me passed young soldiers, young people who all
gave salaam. They were Russian, and their new generations will come under the flag of Mahdi (a); all of them
will come to Islam."
The Csar is coming now to Russia; the Sultan is coming to your countries: Uzbekistan, Kurdistan, Kazakistan,
Bash-kurdistan, and the Khans are coming! The Sultan will come to Istanbul, the Kaiser will come to
Germany and a king to France and Italy. All these people who are making so many dirty things will go, and
with that the whole world will change, becoming a new world with no more dirtiness, finished!
Today is a very holy day on which Allah Almighty always sends His divinely people with divinely powers to
change everything on Earth. Therefore, I am looking to him (a guest) as he is one of them. From Russians a
new generation will be under the flag of the Seal of Prophets (s)! It is a great thing! Glad tidings! Glad tidings!
In your country, Argentina, there will also be a king. From east to west, the flag of Heavens will fly, the holy
flag of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), will be everywhere!

Pray for me also, to reach those holy days and holy people. Whoever is not holy will be taken away.
(Guest: As you said.)
So many bad people will go away and the good people will be with Mahdi (a) and Jesus Christ (a)! Allah,
Allah!
I am the weakest one. There are such powerful saints from east to west, all of them today are on power.
Whatever happened on Earth from the dirtiness of those tyrants, all tyrants will go away, go away, go away,
and heavenly ones will come! I hope who is sending you to me here, I am putting my seal on everyone, and
you will be with Mahdi (a) and Jesus Christ, `Isa (a)!
Yaa Rabbi, yaa Allah! Radina billahi Rabban wa bil Islami dinan, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), nabiyan wa
rasoolan! Allahuma thaabitna `alaa al-Haqq! Allahuma thaabitna `alaa al-Haqq! Allahuma thaabitna `alaa
al-Haqq, bi jaahi man anzalta `alayhi Suratu ‘l-Fatihah.
